Digital lending rules tightened

Advt

The central bank has tightened rules for digital lenders, capping the total cost of credit and requiring explicit borrower consent for each data share. Lenders will have 90 days to align their product stacks with the new norms.

Executives at several platforms said the consent requirement would raise onboarding friction but ultimately strengthen the sector's standing with regulators and lenders alike.
